pages.text: $(l)Placing materials$()$(br)Right-click the altar with an item to put it on the table; once everything is there, right-click with an $(l)empty hand$() to craft.$(br2)$(li)Every recipe has a $(l)main material$(); it floats in the middle of the table.$(li)The other materials can go in any order and may repeat.$(li)Nothing extra may be on the table.

$(l)The four altars$()$(li)Basic Alchemy Altar: 8 places$(li)Transmutation Altar: 12$(li)Truth Altar: 16$(li)Primordial Altar: 16$(br2)Each recipe names the altar it needs; a higher altar can do the lower ones too.
$(l)Crafting$()$(br)Crafting table: 2 amethyst shards, alchemical essence, 3 gold blocks and a crafting table.$(br2)No recipe needed.
